name: Fortune Teller's Talent
oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
{3}{U}: Level 2
As long as you've cast a spell this turn, you may play cards from the top of your library.
{2}{U}: Level 3
Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less to cast.
blocked_sentences: As long as you've cast a spell this turn, you may play cards from the top of your library.

needs.what: a cast_from_library_top permission with no price swap and no spell filter: every spell on top of your library castable at its printed cost (Future Sight's line), here gated by a static condition {cmp: '>', left: {spells_cast_this_turn: 'you'}, right: {const: 0}} and paired with play_lands_from_library_top under the same condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_library_top requires pay_life_instead (Bolas's Citadel) or an affects_spells filter (Thundermane Dragon); the loader raises a DslError on the bare permission, player_statics.library_top_cast_permissions fails closed on an empty filter, and a catch-all filter such as not_types [Land] would be a workaround for a deliberate guard rather than the printed card. Everything else on the card (look_at_library_top, the level lines, the condition, play_lands_from_library_top, the level-3 spell_cost_reduction with not_from_zone hand) is expressible
